description: Source file implementing CUDA symmetric memory utilities, including socket communication for file descriptor passing, environment variable checks for backend selection, and device memory mapping functions.

classes.name: IpcChannel
classes.description: Class for inter-process communication via UNIX domain sockets, supporting file descriptor passing, socket setup, and broadcast/gather operations.

methods.name: device_has_multicast_support
methods.description: Checks if a device supports multicast based on environment variable and device capabilities.

methods.name: allow_overlapping_devices
methods.description: Checks environment variable to determine if overlapping devices are allowed.

methods.name: getSymmMemBackendCUDA
methods.description: Determines the preferred backend for CUDA symmetric memory based on environment variables.

methods.name: IpcChannel::IpcChannel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes socket and socket name for IPC.

methods.name: IpcChannel::~IpcChannel
methods.description: Destructor that closes socket and unlinks socket file.

methods.name: IpcChannel::send_fd
methods.description: Sends a file descriptor to another process via UNIX domain socket.

methods.name: IpcChannel::recv_fd
methods.description: Receives a file descriptor from another process via UNIX domain socket.

methods.name: IpcChannel::all_gather_fds
methods.description: Gathers file descriptors from all processes in a communicator.

methods.name: IpcChannel::broadcast_fds
methods.description: Broadcasts a file descriptor from a source process to all others.

methods.name: IpcChannel::get_socket_name
methods.description: Generates socket filename based on process ID and environment variables.

methods.name: map_block
methods.description: Maps physical memory to virtual address space on CUDA or ROCm devices.
